reason: Recommend the two-gain physical midpoint model: its leave-one-trajectory-out 25-transition (5 s) `x` RMSE is 0.029936 m. The wheel-dead-zone model achieves 0.029800 m, only about 0.000136 m lower, while adding two weakly identifiable parameters; this is not convincing evidence of improvement with three validation trajectories. Other structural candidates give about 0.0306 to 0.0315 m. The recommended model preserves zero-command stationarity and coordinate invariance, has no polynomial extrapolation, and provides the clearest defensible memoryless approximation. Selection uses training-only validation, not inaccessible test results.
